description: Binding append-only registry contract for approved Memory OS release baselines. Historical candidates, CI-compatible commits and branch heads are never release baselines by implication. A record exists only after named multi-role approval and immutable compatibility, recovery and artifact evidence are present.
requiredEvidenceClasses: current exact-source security and authorization evidence
parser artifact registry and retention evidence
load, capacity and operational alert evidence
known open risks with named owners and deadlines

eligibleRequires: binary starts against the expanded target schema
security, tenant, deletion and idempotency invariants remain valid
required parser artifacts and exact object versions remain retained
no destructive contract migration has removed required surfaces
rollback operation and recovery decision are reviewed

forbiddenRecordContent: account, session, job, preview or object identifiers
claims that candidate or local CI evidence is production evidence
registrationGuards: repository HEAD equals the requested commit SHA
release ID and tag have never been registered
commit SHA has never been registered under another release
all evidence references are repository-relative existing files
all required SHA-256 bindings are lowercase 64-character digests
approval roles are complete and assigned to distinct approver identifiers
release record states productionReady false when any required evidence is incomplete
registry update uses exclusive creation semantics and reviewable commit history

readiness.note: The registry authority is defined, but no release is approved. Historical candidate compatibility remains candidate-only and cannot satisfy approved predecessor or rollback evidence.
